about.label: about me
about.title: About
about.headline:
From operations
to code.
about.lead: I'm Sergio Jurado, a full-stack developer. I build software for operations that can't afford to lose the thread: warehouse, logistics, retail and back office.
about.bioTitle: From the floor to the code
about.bio1: I started solving warehouse and retail problems, and ended up writing the software that solves them. That double perspective shapes how I work: understand the process first, choose the tool second.
about.bio2: I work with Nuxt, Astro, Next, Python and Postgres. I care about boring, dependable software: strong types, tests where they matter, reproducible deploys and documentation that doesn't lie.
about.experienceLede: Years managing orders, stock and deliveries. That experience is why the software starts with the process, not the screen.
about.educationLede: Training in systems, image and operations. Each stage added a piece of the judgement I use to build today.
about.principlesLede: It is not a list of values: it is what I apply to every project before writing the first line.

principles.title: Boundaries first
principles.body: Domain, application and infrastructure kept apart. If the framework disappears tomorrow, the business rules still stand.

principles.title: Tokens before components
principles.body: Colour, type and spacing are defined once. Components consume the system instead of improvising values.

principles.title: Boring tools
principles.body: Strict TypeScript, Postgres, tests and CI. Novelty is not a requirement; predictability is.

principles.title: Measure before optimising
principles.body: Performance and SEO are checked with data, not opinions. If it isn't measured, it doesn't get touched.

about.stackSubtitle: What I use daily, not a list of logos to impress.
about.openSourceBody: Author of the KatanaKit family: a TypeScript toolkit, a SCSS framework, a systemd TUI and a code-first WordPress configuration. Four libraries, four different problems.
about.ctaBody: If you have a process that depends on spreadsheets, email or memory, it can probably become software.
about.caption: Full-stack developer · Cambrils, Tarragona
